name: Hoshimi Ren Japanese v1
prompt: An original adult female voice in her early twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Warm, limpid, bell-clear mid-to-upper register with a graceful, soothing Yamato-nadeshiko poise. Pure and luminous timbre without harshness or artificial sweetness, gentle breath support, neat and attentive articulation, calm and quietly steadfast cadence.
